market_pulse.theme: Regulatory crackdown on illegal gambling and black‑market activity
market_pulse.narrative: Multiple regulators and industry bodies are intensifying actions to curb illegal gambling, with new budgets, action plans and alerts targeting black‑market operators and unlicensed promoters across Europe and the UK.

market_pulse.theme: 2026 World Cup impact on gambling operators
market_pulse.narrative: Ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, operators and regulators are issuing alerts on suspicious activity, launching themed gamification engines, and warning about a ‘danger zone’ for unlicensed promotions.
Companies are forging new agreements to enter emerging markets (e.g., Serbia, Africa) and are using high‑profile industry events to showcase partnerships and strengthen B2B networks.
Content providers are releasing fresh slot titles and gamified experiences – such as Shark Feast, Tornado Treasure, and MEGA Shoot – to capture player interest ahead of major sporting events.
